people.bio:
King of Videha at Mithila, elder son of Hrasvaroma (1.71.13). Valmiki calls him only “Janaka”; the personal name Siradhvaja comes from Puranic tradition.

Sources: Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda, Sarga 71 (Janaka recites the Videha lineage); Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda, Sarga 66 (Janaka finds Sita in the furrow).

people.bio:
“Non-uterine” (ayonija) birth: Janaka found her in the furrow while ploughing a ritual field and raised her as his daughter (1.66.13–15). Hence she is called Bhumija, daughter of the Earth. Married Rama (1.73.26–27). Parents are recorded as her adoptive parents.

Sources: Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda, Sarga 66 (Janaka finds Sita in the furrow); Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda, Sarga 71 (Janaka recites the Videha lineage); Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda, Sarga 73 (the four weddings).
Married Rama (Valmiki Ramayana 1.73.26–27, at Mithila).

Sources: Wikipedia, “Lava (Ramayana)” (Shravasti; Ananda Ramayana: wife Sumati).
